name: Trust In Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that trust in marriage is founded on a heart securely placed in the LORD, as trusting in man alone leads to a cursed heart that departs from God (Jeremiah 17:5-7). Within the marriage relationship, the husband’s heart safely trusts in his wife, reflecting a bond marked by righteousness, mercy, and peace (Proverbs 31:11; Psalms 85:10). God’s hatred of treachery and putting away underscores the seriousness of faithfulness in marriage, calling believers to guard their hearts against lust and betrayal (Malachi 2:16; Matthew 5:28).
